Melbourne converts IB results to an Australian selection rank; the lowest that led to an offer in 2026 was 92.00 (guide only). Prerequisites: at least 4 in English (A or B, SL or HL) and at least 4 in Mathematics Analysis and Approaches (HL or SL) or Applications and Interpretation HL.
CBSE (AISSC) or ISC: 92.00 (2027 guide only), with English and Mathematics.
